description: A complete voiceover production studio: timed scripts, delivery direction, audio tags, casting, voice design, clone prep, pronunciation, timing, sync, localization, sound effects, music, QA, and render-ready output.

capabilities: Write timed voiceover scripts for ads, shorts, explainers, podcasts, audiobooks, and e-learning
Add delivery direction and inline audio tags so AI voices perform instead of read
Cast or design the right voice and prepare consented voice clone recordings
Fix pronunciation of names, acronyms, numbers, and foreign words
Time scripts to picture, captions, and fixed ad slots
Localize scripts for dubbing and write sound effect and music prompts
Export clean render-ready text for AI text-to-speech tools
defaultPrompt: Write a voiceover script for my project.
Make my script sound natural and ready for an AI voice.
Help me plan the voice, pacing, and delivery for my audio.
interface.longDescription: Turn ideas, drafts, blog posts, or transcripts into production-ready voiceover scripts with timing, pacing, delivery direction, and audio cues. Create scripts for ads, short videos, explainers, e-learning, podcasts, audiobooks, meditation, games, IVR, and voice agents. Get help with voice casting, consented voice-clone preparation, pronunciation, dubbing, sync, sound and music prompts, quality checks, cost estimates, and clean text for AI voice tools.

name: voiceover-lab
